question_snapshot.stem_en: A section of Indian citizens residing in India has a distinct script but is not a minority in its State. It claims Article 29(1) protection to conserve the script. Which response is correct?
options_en: Article 29(1) applies only if the group also qualifies as an Article 30 minority.
The right is not confined to minorities; the text protects any qualifying section of citizens.
The group must have a distinct language, script and culture together; a distinct script alone is insufficient.
Article 29(1) protects only a minority institution’s administration, not conservation of a script.

question_snapshot.stem_en: Which comparison correctly describes the express holders of rights under Articles 25(1) and 29(1)?

Article 25(1) protects citizens alone, while Article 29(1) expressly protects every resident irrespective of citizenship.
Article 29(1) protects only religious minorities, while Article 25(1) protects only linguistic minorities.
